conventions.root: free joint: position (x, y, z) then orientation quaternion (w, x, y, z), world frame
conventions.hinges: every joint is a hinge; hip_y, knee, ankle_y, shoulder, elbow about the body's +y (hip flexion forward is negative, knee flexion positive); hip_x and ankle_x about +x (a positive left hip_x abducts the left leg, a positive right hip_x adducts the right)
conventions.phase: a clip is periodic in phase in [0, 1); bins are at phase b / nb; interpolate linearly between bins (quaternions by normalised interpolation); dx and dy have nb + 1 entries at the phase edges 0, 1/nb, ..., 1
conventions.playing: phase += dt / dur; root.x += dx(phase1) - dx(phase0) + dx[nb] per wrap; root.y = start + dy(phase); root.z = root_z(phase); joints = angles(phase); orientation = quat(phase)
conventions.transitions: blend two clips in phase space over about a second (joints, orientation, dur, dx, dy, root_z interpolated; joints only one clip has enter at that clip's values); switch the skeleton at the start of the blend; the phase and the root position are continuous

style.note: the style layer: add the offsets to the shoulders and elbows, keep a quarter of their swing, pitch the torso forward; the legless body keeps its arms and its pitch
